channel.description: Latest articles from European Medical Journal (emjreviews.com)

item.title: Quantitative Coronary CT Plaque Measures Predict MACE Risk
item.description: Quantitative coronary CT plaque measures independently predicted major adverse cardiovascular events, improving risk stratification in patients. The post Quantitative Coronary CT Plaque Measures Predict MACE Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AMH and AFC Do Not Predict Embryo Euploidy in IVF
item.description: AMH and AFC levels do not independently predict embryo euploidy in patients undergoing IVF, a 2026 cohort study has found. The post AMH and AFC Do Not Predict Embryo Euploidy in IVF appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: High Sugar Drink Intake Linked to COPD Risk
item.description: A new study finds adults consuming more sugary drinks have higher odds of COPD, highlighting links between diet, lung health, and overall wellbeing. The post High Sugar Drink Intake Linked to COPD Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Maternal Kidney Disease Linked to Higher Congenital Malformation Risk
item.description: A nationwide cohort study finds higher rates of congenital malformations in babies born to mothers with chronic and end-stage kidney disease. The post Maternal Kidney Disease Linked to Higher Congenital Malformation Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: 20-Year Study Reveals Cognitive Training Reduces Dementia Risk
item.description: Long-term trial data suggest speed-based cognitive training with boosters may reduce the risk of dementia diagnosis years later. The post 20-Year Study Reveals Cognitive Training Reduces Dementia Risk appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Cranberry Extract Supports Intestinal Barrier Function
item.description: Cranberry extract supports intestinal barrier function by promoting mucin secretion, antimicrobial activity, and microbiota-driven epithelial reinforcement. The post Cranberry Extract Supports Intestinal Barrier Function appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Allergic Rhinitis Alters COVID 19 Symptoms
item.description: A study of 1,368 participants shows allergic rhinitis alters COVID 19 symptoms, with sublingual immunotherapy increasing respiratory risk but lowering fever incidence. The post Allergic Rhinitis Alters COVID 19 Symptoms appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Tirzepatide Superior to Semaglutide in Weight Reduction
item.description: Tirzepatide proves superior to semaglutide in weight reduction and improving glycaemic indices, a 2026 network meta-analysis has found. The post Tirzepatide Superior to Semaglutide in Weight Reduction appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: Frailty and Oral Health Signal Malnutrition
item.description: In rural older adults, frailty and reduced chewing performance were linked to a higher risk of malnutrition in southern Taiwan too. The post Frailty and Oral Health Signal Malnutrition appeared first on European Medical Journal.

item.title: AI Improves Pulmonary Embolism Detection
item.description: AI models accurately detected pulmonary embolism on imaging, though accuracy dropped when tested in external datasets overall, too. The post AI Improves Pulmonary Embolism Detection appeared first on European Medical Journal.
